title: ViTacPhys: Physical Property-Aware Grasping from Human Visual-Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Recent vision-based action models have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex manipulation, but they rarely leverage explicit object physical properties to adapt their policies. We introduce ViTacPhys, a visual-tactile framework and data acquisition system that estimates object mass and friction-coefficient classes, together with continuous stiffness, from human manipulation demonstrations. Trained on data from 60 rigid and deformable objects, ViTacPhys combines temporal visual-tactile modeling, cross-attention multimodal fusion, and a semantic prior derived from a vision-language model. On seen objects, it achieves 97.2% mass classification accuracy, 98.8% friction-coefficient classification accuracy, and a stiffness mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 5.51%. On held-out objects from known categories, it achieves 87.5% mass accuracy, 97.5% friction-coefficient accuracy, and a stiffness MAPE of 9.08%. We transfer ViTacPhys from the human domain to the robot domain using limited robot teleoperation data, robot-style video augmentation, and human demonstrations with matched actions, and deploy it as an online module for adaptive grasping. The resulting physical-property-conditioned policy achieves total grasping success rates of 95.0% on in-distribution objects and 83.4% on out-of-distribution objects. For out-of-distribution objects successfully grasped by both methods, its force profiles are more consistent with human teleoperation than those produced by ACT. These results demonstrate the feasibility of explicitly estimating and conditioning on object physical properties for real-world adaptive grasping.

AI.problem: 论文聚焦视觉-触觉条件下的自适应抓取任务。现有基于视觉的智能体运动模型虽在复杂操作中表现强，但很少利用显式的物体物理属性（如质量、摩擦系数、刚度）来调整策略，导致抓取策略缺乏物理感知的适应性。论文试图解决的关键问题是：如何从人类操作演示中估计物体的物理属性，并将这些物理属性显式地作为条件输入，用于真实世界的自适应抓取。
AI.method: 论文提出 ViTacPhys，一个视觉-触觉框架与数据采集系统。技术路线包括：从人类操作演示中估计物体的质量类别、摩擦系数类别和连续刚度；模型结合时间维度视觉-触觉建模、交叉注意力多模态融合，以及由视觉-语言模型（VLM）得到的语义先验。训练数据来自 60 个刚性和可变形物体。在从人类域迁移到机器人域时，采用有限的机器人遥操作数据、机器人风格视频增强，以及与人类演示动作匹配的方式，并将其部署为在线模块用于自适应抓取，形成物理属性条件化的抓取策略。
AI.experiment: 在已见物体上，ViTacPhys 达到 97.2% 的质量分类准确率、98.8% 的摩擦系数分类准确率，以及刚度的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为 5.51%。在已知类别的留出物体上，质量准确率为 87.5%、摩擦系数准确率为 97.5%、刚度 MAPE 为 9.08%。部署后，物理属性条件化策略的抓取成功率在分布内物体上为 95.0%，在分布外物体上为 83.4%。对于两种方法均成功抓取的分布外物体，其力轨迹相比 ACT 与人类遥操作更一致。摘要未提及基准比较的完整实验设置细节。
